# Confuse

Source: https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/readme.md

# Confuse

An all-Elixir parser for libconfuse style config files.

It is primarily made to serve the Nerves ecosystem as our firmware update tool
of choice, `fwup`, uses libconfuse for config. Happy to expand capability over
time.

## Installation

Most easily installed with Igniter:

```sh
mix archive.install hex igniter_new && mix igniter.install confuse
```

The package can be installed by adding `confuse` to your list of dependencies
in `mix.exs`:

```elixir
def deps do
  [
    {:confuse, "~> 0.1.0"}
  ]
end
```

## Usage

Parsing a file produces a map that is the structured form of the config file.
The structured form can still be a bit unwieldy, open to suggestions on
making it nicer.

```elixir
{:ok, parsed} =
  "fwup.conf"
  |> File.read!()
  |> Confuse.parse()
```

# Confuse

Source: https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.md

# `Confuse`
[🔗](https://github.com/underjord/confuse/blob/main/lib/confuse.ex#L1)

Parse config files based on the libconfuse format.

# `parse`

```elixir
@spec parse(data :: String.t()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, :parsing_failed}
```

Parse a configuration string into a structured map.

*Consult [api-reference.md](api-reference.md) for complete listing*

# Confuse.Fwup

Source: https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.Fwup.md

# `Confuse.Fwup`
[🔗](https://github.com/underjord/confuse/blob/main/lib/confuse/fwup.ex#L1)

Special-purpose functionality for usage of config files by the [fwup](https://github.com/fwup-home/fwup) tool.

Primarily to provide functionality for Nerves firmware update introspection.

# `validation`

```elixir
@type validation() :: %{
  delta_source_raw_offset?: boolean(),
  delta_source_raw_count?: boolean(),
  delta_source_raw_options_cipher?: boolean(),
  delta_source_raw_options_secret?: boolean(),
  raw_write?: boolean(),
  raw_write_cipher?: boolean(),
  raw_write_secret?: boolean(),
  raw_deltas_valid?: boolean(),
  delta_source_fat_offset?: boolean(),
  delta_source_fat_path?: boolean(),
  fat_write?: boolean(),
  fat_deltas_valid?: boolean()
}
```

# `get_delta_files`

```elixir
@spec get_delta_files(file :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, map()} | {:error, :parsing_failed | File.posix()}
```

# `get_delta_files_from_config`

```elixir
@spec get_delta_files_from_config(config_data :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, map()} | {:error, :parsing_failed | File.posix()}
```

# `get_feature_usage`

```elixir
@spec get_feature_usage(file :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, Confuse.Fwup.Features.t()} | {:error, :parsing_failed | File.posix()}
```

# `get_feature_usage_from_config`

```elixir
@spec get_feature_usage_from_config(config_data :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, Confuse.Fwup.Features.t()} | {:error, :parsing_failed | File.posix()}
```

# `get_upgrade_task_files`

```elixir
@spec get_upgrade_task_files(file :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, [String.t()]} | {:error, :parsing_failed | File.posix()}
```

# `get_upgrade_tasks_files_from_config`

```elixir
@spec get_upgrade_tasks_files_from_config(config_data :: String.t()) ::
  {:ok, [String.t()]} | {:error, :parsing_failed}
```

# `validate_delta`

```elixir
@spec validate_delta(
  source_meta_conf :: String.t(),
  target_meta_conf :: String.t(),
  using_fwup_version :: nil | Version.t()
) :: :ok | {:error, [String.t()]}
```

# Confuse.Fwup.Features

Source: https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.Fwup.Features.md

# `Confuse.Fwup.Features`
[🔗](https://github.com/underjord/confuse/blob/main/lib/confuse/fwup.ex#L8)

Fwup features.

Data structure to provide information about fwup features detected in a config file.

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Confuse.Fwup.Features{
  block_cache_size_mb: non_neg_integer() | nil,
  complete_fwup_version: Version.t(),
  delta_fwup_version: Version.t(),
  encrypted_deltas?: boolean(),
  encryption?: boolean(),
  fat_deltas?: boolean(),
  raw_deltas?: boolean(),
  specified_fwup_version: Version.t() | nil,
  valid?: boolean()
}
```

# `squash`

```elixir
@spec squash([Confuse.Fwup.validation()], String.t() | nil) :: t()
```
